name: Grixis Commander Encyclopedia — M6/M7 Secondary Completion Sub-Tracker

accounting.unit: binary gate completion; PARTIAL counts as 0 until full stated gate is completed
accounting.percent_meaning: share of named subordinate gate checkboxes completed; NOT M6 acceptance, certified decks, budget, or simulation-validity percentage
accounting.official_milestone_acceptance_authority: data/grixis/registry.json → program.milestones; only the user may accept
accounting.certified_count_source: formal schema-valid current-cycle deck certificates, not historical canonical approvals
accounting.warning: Do not equate M7 review decisions with the 62 existing approvals; do not count authored reviews as independent Pass C; do not count paired goldfish/source access/scripted fixtures as completed effect-aware Phase B.

legend.COMPLETE: The gate as stated is done; the evidence limitation is included in its scope.
legend.PARTIAL: Some relevant work exists, but the gate is unfulfilled.
legend.BLOCKED: Required prerequisite or evidence is absent.
legend.NOT_STARTED: No qualifying milestone work has begun; prior infrastructure may exist.

gates.title: Accepted M5 source inputs and provenance
gates.scope: The 62 accepted Birthday M5 inputs and input provenance are available; no deck-change authorization.

gates.title: Two objective-specific technical optimizer projections
gates.scope: Pass A/B artifact projections sealed in distinct commits; NOT proof of independent executors or strict two-party blinding.

gates.title: Reconciliation and deep-review queue generated
gates.scope: All decks have a reconciliation queue; 8,848 material candidate reviews in deep-review inventory, not 8,848 resolved disagreements.

gates.title: Commander-first source-specific detailed review
gates.scope: 15 decks have authored specific-candidate judgments; 12 exact-swap HOLDs and 3 promising unresolved cases. Not formal independent Pass C; 47 decks not covered by this authored sequence.

gates.title: Named genuinely independent Pass C and disagreement resolution
gates.scope: Pass C remains awaiting named independent critic; author-authored preliminary reviews cannot satisfy this gate.

gates.title: Effect-aware Phase B paired tests, stress and red-team coverage
gates.scope: Bounded source/draw/mana/rules probes are run for 3 example decks; 0 decks have complete effect-aware Phase B plus stress/red-team certification.

gates.title: Decision-grade judgment_review and conflicts resolved
gates.scope: M5 screening and author-written HOLDs are insufficient; complete decision-class judgment receipts needed.

gates.title: I: tested-pool local zero-improvement certificates
gates.scope: No valid tested-pool local-optimum certificate can issue before independent review, judgment and required Phase B.

gates.title: J: final reproducibility and evidence bundles
gates.scope: 62 preliminary I/J input receipts exist, but 0 final complete reproducibility bundles are certified.

gates.title: Schema-valid final M6 packets and user acceptance
gates.scope: No M6-approved READY/REQUIRED conclusions for 62 current-cycle decks, no explicit user acceptance.

m7.depends_on: M6 decision-ready schema-valid packets; no automatic use of historical approved/locked state

gates.title: Receive M6-complete decision packets
gates.scope: Requires M6 certification; preparatory M6 packets do not count.

gates.title: Record Cory's explicit decision for every packet
gates.scope: The 62 existing canonical approvals are distinct from the second-cycle decisions required for M7.

gates.title: Verify reviewed/approved hashes against registry
gates.scope: Verify hashes of M7 reviewed versions, not simply current historical approvals.

gates.title: Re-close any changed decks through cycle-2 verification
gates.scope: Conditional on user-approved edits; unchanged approved decks must not be reopened automatically.

gates.title: Process relevant reopen triggers and planned releases
gates.scope: Includes documented planned 2026-11-13 release trigger; do not predeclare a future event processed.

gates.title: User accepts M7 after all packet decisions/rechecks
gates.scope: Requires explicit human milestone acceptance; no automatic status change.

display.note: 30% is a descriptive gate-count fraction; it does NOT imply 30% of all 62 decks are certified, nor that equally weighted development work is done.
